verdict.rationale: Slack's own Workflow Builder lets any user combine triggers and steps into no-code automations. It adds conditional branching for rule-like logic and webhook triggers that start workflows from outside events, so the product directly delivers event-triggered automated actions. The Events API is a developer building block and is not credited. Missing for 10: an enumeration of which in-Slack events can act as triggers (the docs say only 'a limited set'), depth of conditional rule logic beyond branching on user interaction, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Any user can combine a limited set of steps and triggers to quickly set up an automation.
